Name: Simple Infinite Crafting and Cooking
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]Simple Infinite Crafting and Cooking[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]For PC single-player. Multiplayer and split-screen are disabled.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]♾️ Craft & Cook Freely[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use learned recipes in the normal crafting tab, kitchen or cookout kit. By default, ingredients are not required and nothing is consumed. Crafting and cooking can be enabled separately.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54106/54106-1792338947-1924441244.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🥚 Choose Your Rules[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Enable Require ingredients to keep the normal ingredient checks while retaining everything used. Keep Qi Seasoning preserves seasoning you already have when cooking; seasoning must still be available to obtain its quality bonus.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]⚙️ Settings & Compatibility[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu provides the settings; config.json also works. Custom recipes using the normal game crafting system are included. Replacement crafting menus with their own ingredient systems may need separate support. Recipes must still be learned.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54106/54106-1792338947-138154435.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]📦 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0 or newer. Install SMAPI, then extract this mod’s folder into Mods. Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. Remove the mod folder to uninstall; existing crafted items remain.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🌍 Languages[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Italian and Hungarian.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requested by Harold45. Code and translations were created with AI assistance. Settings previews are rendered with the game’s fonts and the installed GMCM; crafting and cooking images are composed native menu previews.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please share the mod version, game/SMAPI version and platform, what happened versus what you expected, and steps to reproduce. Include a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url] and a screenshot or short video when helpful. Suggestions are welcome: explain what you would like changed and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
